issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated directly into URL paths without percent-encoding, so IDs containing '/' or reserved characters hit the wrong endpoint.
Transient httpx transport errors such as timeouts and connection resets are not retried and escape as raw httpx exceptions.
Successful responses are parsed with unchecked json()/dict access, causing JSONDecodeError or KeyError instead of a typed protocol/API error.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After values.
backoff_base and backoff_cap are not validated, allowing negative or nonsensical sleep durations.
BatchItemResult accepts invalid status values and inconsistent task/error combinations despite declaring a Literal status type.
ReviewResult does not validate verdict at runtime, unlike other model classes with constrained values.
Package is advertised as typed but does not ship a py.typed marker for PEP 561 type-checker consumers.
__version__ duplicates pyproject.toml version and can drift from the packaged release metadata.
Examples dereference exc.error/r.error without guarding None, which can fail for unstructured error responses.
